acknowledgement: My sole research target is the full uniform quadratic-form bounded-density statement under the exact owner quantifiers; no diagonal, sign, support, moment, or rotated-independence restriction is being substituted.

latest_substantive_result.scope: If a disjoint m x m coordinate cross block A[I,J] is invertible for m>=3, then ||p_Q||_infinity <= [m/(m-2)] |det A[I,J]|^{-1/m}; in particular a 3 x 3 cross block gives 3|det|^{-1/3}. This is a structural branch, not the full conjecture.

first_unresolved_implication: Replace single disjoint cross-minor selection by an overlap-aware structural/analytic aggregation that stays uniform when rank-three spectral mass shares hub coordinates and also handles arbitrary extra eigendirections.
next_attempt: Use the account02/B03 overlap-collapse family to derive a quantitative hub-versus-disjoint dichotomy at the level of exact row-frame Gram determinants, then feed the surviving branch into a time-integrated Plancherel estimate rather than a pointwise decay claim.
